entity: New Mexico homicide clearance rate, 2022-23, lowest in the nation
what_we_add: Lowest of 51 both years at 22-23% vs 56% national, and the one-year 2018 cliff from 59% to 34%
why: 24/7 Wall St's unsolved-murders ranking carries NM's 2022 numbers (47 of 235 solved, about 20%, within 25% of our 22.3%); Stateline names NM among the lowest for violent-crime clearance in 2024. The 2018 cliff and both-years-lowest claim are ours alone.
